text: The City Manager will give a presentation on COVID-19 Recovery Update.

The Board of Health: 1. Requested the Medical Officer of Health, in consultation with the City Manager, to consult with communities disproportionately affected by the COVID-19 pandemic and to report back in 2022 with an update on the status of implementing the recommendations from the Toronto Office of Recovery and Rebuild that pertain to public health and the social determinants of health.
